brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ, landscape 16:9, target 1536×864 or larger, opaque PNG.

Editorial basis: ONLY the supplied fixed source.html/source.txt for 2026-11-06. It is a results article with ALL official results still unconfirmed at 19:51 JST. Do not imply any winner, score, individual performance, appearance in that game, ranking, or a completed match. The figure is an illustrative image, not a reconstruction of an actual event.

Art direction: match the approved black-and-lime ink illustration aesthetic already viewed: near-black #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B, warm ivory typography, coarse handmade ink hatching, broad dry-brush strokes, sparse energetic flecks. Strong editorial hierarchy, few elements, readable Japanese. Do not copy the reference thumbnail's athlete, player name, statistics or composition.

Main subject: exactly ONE real player, Hibiki Yamane / 山根響 of Shinagawa, randomly selected from names in the fixed article. He is an adult Japanese male basketball guard. His identity and appearance were visually checked in the official 2026-27 profile at https://basketball.shinagawa-city.com/team/players/detail/id=60025?PlayerID=43471 and its official portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026110620/files/user/roster/748/2026-27/43471_01.jpg.
Preserve the observed distinctive likeness: smooth clean-shaven long oval face narrowing gently to a small rounded chin; medium-length straight dark black hair with a clear center part, rounded curtain-like sides reaching the top of the ears and separated strands exposing the forehead; fine straight eyebrows, narrow almond dark eyes, straight slim nose, small relaxed lips; lean athletic shoulders and arms, ordinary realistic guard proportions. NOT a generic fictional player, not a beard, not a buzz cut, not curly hair. Draw entirely as hand-inked sports illustration, never photographic.

Composition: athlete in LEFT 43% of canvas, face clearly visible in a subtle three-quarter angle, torso leaning forward, one bent knee and the other leg extending back in a driving step. Both hands naturally gather ONE orange basketball at his outer left hip while moving, fingers anatomically coherent, ball visibly held. Plain ivory basketball jersey and shorts with minimal black folds and lime edging, absolutely no team name, number, crest, sponsor, brand or league logo. Keep face, hands, ball, and feet comfortably inside the frame. No other people, no crowd faces, no actual game setting. A single diagonal lime brush sweep adds movement behind him.

RIGHT 52%: bold, clean, very large Japanese typography, consistent alignment and ample margins. Top small brand and date, central headline, then a prominent lime status line. Avoid text overlapping the athlete. Bottom footer remains unobscured. Use these exact text strings, and no other words, letters or numbers:
「バスケまとめ」
「11/06 試合結果」
「公式記録の」
「確定待ち」
「2026.11.06 19:51 JST時点」
「イラスト（AI生成）」
「イメージ」

Typography hierarchy: 「公式記録の」 and 「確定待ち」 form the biggest and clearest two-line message, with 「確定待ち」 in lime. 「11/06 試合結果」 is large but secondary. Date-time is smaller and fully legible. Both 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」 must be clearly visible together in the footer with safe padding.
No individual player name or performance text anywhere. Do not write 成績をもとにしたイメージ since this player was randomly chosen. No fabricated actual-game claims, no watermarks, no pasted official photographs. Render as polished hand-painted editorial artwork.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION:
Edit the first image, the generated Japanese basketball thumbnail. The second image is an OFFICIAL IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY, the portrait of real player Hibiki Yamane (山根 響). Do not paste or reproduce the photograph, its jersey, sponsor text, team logo, number, or background. It is used only to make the illustration unmistakably closer to this actual person.

Keep the entire right-side layout, all exact Japanese text, all dates and numerals, palette (#151A18 black and #CCF43B lime), orange ball, hand-drawn ink and brush style, and the same subject/action. ONE athlete only, no additional people. Preserve the accurate text exactly:
バスケまとめ
11/06 試合結果
公式記録の
確定待ち
2026.11.06 19:51 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ

Make only these corrections on the LEFT athlete:
1. Redraw his face and hair to closely match the official portrait's identity while maintaining fully hand-illustrated ink rendering. Use the portrait's long smooth oval face, soft cheeks, small rounded chin, slim straight nose, small lips, fine flatter eyebrows, and relatively narrow, less exaggerated almond eyes. Remove the generic anime-model sharp jaw and dramatic eyes. He is clean-shaven. Hair should match the portrait: medium-length straight black center-parted curtain hair, rounded sides at ear level, clean exposed forehead and simple natural strands. Less wavy and windswept than the current illustration. Retain three-quarter view and focused expression naturally derived from this face.
2. Slightly reduce and reposition the whole athlete within the left panel, creating clear safe margin above the hair and below BOTH shoes. Fit the complete dynamic stepping pose inside the frame with no clipped limbs. Keep face large enough to recognize. Do not shrink the typography.
3. Hands remain anatomically natural, two hands with five fingers each gripping the one basketball, with sensible partial occlusion. Keep the uniform plain ivory with simple lime and black edging and NO markings.

Everything must remain a sports editorial illustration, not photographic. No player name on image, no statistics, no score. This is explicitly an imagined generic play, not a factual game moment. Deliver one corrected opaque PNG, same 16:9 canvas and at least 1536px wide.

visual_review.text_and_numbers: 最終画像を目視し、指定した7本の文字列・日付・時刻を確認。誤字、選手名、個人成績、確定スコアなし。
visual_review.source_qualifiers: 『公式記録の 確定待ち』『2026.11.06 19:51 JST時点』を判読できる大きさで確認。勝敗や当日の出場・実績を断定していない。
visual_review.likeness_or_no_named_person: 実在選手1人。公式プロフィール写真と最終イラストを比較し、髪型・輪郭・目鼻・ひげなしの特徴を確認。顔は手描きのイラストとして表現。
visual_review.layout: 16:9に近い横長。本文、顔、両手、ボール、両足が枠内に収まり、重要要素の見切れ・重なりなし。両手はボールを保持し、不自然な余分の指・肢なし。チーム・リーグ・スポンサーのロゴなし。
visual_review.ai_label: 画像下部の『イラスト（AI生成）』『イメージ』を目視確認。
